comment: Production trust root for external capability packs.
It contains PUBLIC keys only, and today it contains none: no external
publisher has been onboarded, so every external pack resolves to
Adding a publisher is a data change here (public key + key_id + status);
no private key material exists in this repository and none is needed to
verify. Revocation is 'status': 'revoked' on the key entry - keep the
entry so a signature made with it is reported as REVOKED_KEY instead of
degrading into the indistinguishable 'unknown publisher' state.
